items.Sentence: The Discharger ceased continuous effluent disinfection using chlorination/dechlorination at Discharge Point 001 (120" outfall). However, sodium hypochlorite has been used as oxidant chemical to treat foul air (i.e., H2S control) in scrubbers at primary treatment process and to control the bulking from filamentous organisms in the return activated sludge (RAS), which probably causes RP for total chlorine residual.
